scope: Section-level audit; not a completed item-by-item proof of every requirement

entries.requirement: Original EXE and permitted local user-mode execution
entries.finding: Original hash checked each browser launch; source is inspection input only.

entries.requirement: Inspection, shaders, imports, licenses, native reference attempt
entries.finding: No native scene reference was obtained; local-only distribution constraint remains.

entries.requirement: Concrete execution path and preserved baseline
entries.finding: Historical architecture note needs current-state reading; implementation owns GPU in a separate worker.

entries.requirement: Real scene, required resources, original shaders and alpha/stencil ordering
entries.finding: Independent rasterization conformance is not proved by shared-path equivalence.

entries.requirement: Coordinate conventions, culling and pixel-center reference coverage
entries.finding: Naga final-output correction adds W/viewportWidth to clip X and subtracts W/viewportHeight from clip Y. Independent GPU integer-center coverage passes fixed, programmable non-unit W, and offset viewport cases; original camera and lighting-equivalence captures pass.

entries.requirement: Bounded queue, resource lifetimes, resident caches and sampled capture
entries.finding: Large uploads remain synchronous after flushing; queue has explicit bounds/backpressure.
WASM/tracked GPU/cache measured separately. Browser-wide API exposed but timed out after 30s during original execution; total browser memory and guest allocation detail remain unmeasured.
No Wine-based solution selected; historical Linux checkpoint is not a rendering comparison.

entries.requirement: Hardware browser, local page, controls, bounded upload and isolation
entries.finding: No public deployment; user-started four-hour run not executed.

entries.requirement: Recognizable multi-frame scene and controlled input
entries.finding: Three inspected captures with camera changed while held and stable after release.

Corrected 1280x720 renderer: three cold and three warm timing-only trials plus six separately inspected scene captures. Two current 60-second runs measured 56.55 and 77.17 Present submissions/s; cause of variability unmeasured. Longer stability trial predates pixel correction. Submission timing is not display delivery.

entries.requirement: Available GPU/CPU timing and complete transfer accounting
entries.finding: GPU/host draw timings measured. Resource snapshots now cover page, CPU and GPU workers including shader WASM; navigation document and exact wire accounting remain outside this scope.

entries.requirement: Reproducible scripts, original launch, evidence and current report
entries.finding: Summarizer now requires explicit run, validates visual-review identity/hashes, and defaults to a separate output.

nextAction: Investigate current throughput variability, refresh longer stability, and complete available memory/transfer accounting.
